title: Valves / Fluid Control Components
description: Slender shaft, small diameter, high aspect ratio, precision conical/spherical sealing surface
designPrinciples: Material: Grade 5 (Ti-6Al-4V) offers high strength (yield>=830MPa) and good toughness with superior hydrogen embrittlement resistance vs CP-Ti. Use TC4 ELI for biocompatibility requirements.
Form: Slender shafts suitable for Swiss-type turning from bar stock, 60-70% material utilization, 50% cost reduction vs plate cutting + welding.
comparisonNotes: Standards: Annealed (A), UT Class B, Ra<=0.4um, sealing surface Ra<=0.2um
